name: Fishing Chef (Update)
desc:
🎣 Fishing Chef is an open-world fishing and cooking adventure!

☀️ By day, catch rare fish and mythical creatures.
🌙 By night, cook delicious dishes and serve hungry customers.
🐟 Discover hundreds of unique fish, master new dishes, and complete exciting quests!

Do you have what it takes to become the legendary Fishing Chef and run a five-star restaurant?

Inspired by Fisch, Fish it and Dave the Diver
